3 Output Conversion with 3C Helper 3.1 Understanding TLF Formats RapTLR’s run_apdx() function inserts TLFs into your Word document. To work properly, your outputs must be in .DOCX format. As outputs are generally .RTF they need to be converted as .DOCX and for that the tool 3C Helper is used. 3.2 What is 3C Helper? 3C Helper is a companion tool that converts various output formats to .DOCX. The purpose of this tool is to convert your RTF outputs generated by SAS into DOCX and use them to create for each a bookmark and incorporate them into the TLR document. 3.3 How to download 3C Helper You can download 3C Helper on this page and click on Download 3C Helper, version 2.1.5. If needed you can read the user guide in Clonfluence on this page. 3.4 Converting your RTF outputs into DOCX 3.4.1 Example from the TLR package In the R package we provided dummy rtf outputs that you can use to practice with 3C Helper. They are also accessible here. You can use the function import_RTFs() to copy and create a clone folder of dummy rtf outputs in your working directory. See below. library(RapTLR) import_RTFs() If succeeded in your console you should receive in the console this message [INFO] rtf_outputs folder has been successfully imported and copied under: ... 3.4.2 Summary video (no sound) The following recording shows in details how to use the import_RTFs() function and 3C Helper to convert RTF outputs into DOCX format. 3.5 Working with SPACE When creating your TLR, the outputs should be saved in SPACE in PREPROD or PROD. When you connect your R Session to the corresponding RE, R automatically creates libpaths that you can use to access the different folders and pillar in SPACE. In the following steps, we tried to imitate a propoer study structure using the compound test_compound. 3.5.1 Accessing the Report Effort The first step is to get access to the compound called test_compound in SPACE. To have access, you need to summit this SAM request: Select Environment: PROD Request Type: Add Access Compound: test_compound Therapeutic Area: None -> Click on Other TA Other TA: Test_compound access Selecting Existing SPACE User: Find yourself Add attachments: Provide a word document with the sentence Accessing test_compound 3.6 Quality Checks Before Processing Before using run_apdx(), verify: All files are .RTF Files open correctly Consistent naming
